claims.text: Many reviewers report the product works well, leaving hair soft, silky, shiny, and improving body and split ends.
Several reviewers complain the product is misrepresented as organic, noting the bottle label does not list organic ingredients and differs from the webpage listing.
Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as pleasant or amazing.
Some reviewers report inconsistent quality or unexpected contents across repeat orders.
A few reviewers note the shampoo does not lather much, which some attribute to being sulfate free.
